text: The car would not start this morning. The dashboard lights were dim and the battery seemed completely flat after two days parked.
While driving on the motorway the battery warning light came on and the engine lost power, then the car stopped in the fast lane.
The charging cable gets very hot at the plug when the vehicle is plugged in overnight, and there is a burning smell in the garage.
The 12 volt socket in the boot has stopped working and the phone charger no longer receives any power from it.
The vehicle reports a charging fault and refuses to charge above eighty percent, even at a public fast charger.
After the battery was replaced the radio asks for a code and the clock resets every time the car is started.
Smoke came from under the bonnet while the car was charging and the battery pack was later found to be damaged.
The brake warning light stays on after the handbrake is released and the pedal feels soft when stopping at low speed.
The stability control light flashes on dry tarmac and the car briefly cuts power while pulling away from a junction.
The rear brakes squeal every morning for the first few stops and then the noise disappears for the rest of the day.
The parking brake engages by itself while the car is parked on a slight slope, and the switch does not release it.
The brake pedal went to the floor at a traffic light and the car rolled into the vehicle in front, damaging the bumper.
A warning says the brake system needs service and the cruise control refuses to engage on the motorway.
The left headlight is much dimmer than the right one and oncoming drivers flash their lights at night.
The turn signals stopped working on both sides, and the hazard lights also fail to flash when the switch is pressed.
Water collects inside the tail light housing and the bulb fails every few weeks, leaving the rear of the car unlit at night.
The interior boot lamp does not switch on when the tailgate opens, although every other interior light works.
The automatic high beam switches back to low beam too late when another car approaches on a country road.
The dashboard reports a lighting fault, but every exterior lamp appears to work when checked from outside the car.
The rear light bar flickers and then goes out completely while driving, so following traffic cannot see the car.
